source_video.title: Industrial factory operation with machinery and workers

inspection.source_name: Industrial factory operation with machinery and workers
inspection.analysis_provider: OpenRouter vision review + YOLO object detection
inspection.analysis_summary: Frames show an indoor bulk-material handling operation with a wheel loader, conveyor/screening equipment, stockpiled bags, and workers. Visible dust/particulate clouds are present during loader and conveyor activity. Workers are seen near moving equipment and inside a material bin; PPE is partially visible (hi-vis, mask, gloves, hard hat in some frames), but respiratory/eye protection is not clearly visible on all workers in dust-generating areas.

events.title: DUST CLOUD AROUND LOADER AND CONVEYOR DISCHARGE
events.visible_evidence: A visible dust cloud forms around the loader bucket and the conveyor discharge while material is being moved.
events.why_it_matters: Airborne particulate can reduce visibility and may create an inhalation exposure during bulk-material handling.
events.recommended_follow_up: Review dust-suppression controls and confirm that respiratory protection is appropriate for the task and exposure.

events.title: WORKER ON ELEVATED PLATFORM NEAR OPERATING LOADER
events.visible_evidence: A worker in a red shirt is visible on the right-side platform while the loader bucket is raised close to the platform area at approximately 4.96 seconds.
events.why_it_matters: Close proximity between pedestrians and moving machinery can increase struck-by or crush risk if visibility or separation is inadequate.
events.recommended_follow_up: Confirm physical segregation, spotter communication, and exclusion zones during loader operation.

events.title: DUST HAZE AROUND CONVEYOR/SCREENING AREA
events.visible_evidence: A dust haze is visible around the conveyor/screening area, with a worker visible in the background.
events.why_it_matters: Dust around active material-transfer equipment can affect visibility and may expose nearby workers to airborne particulate.
events.recommended_follow_up: Check local extraction or suppression at the transfer point and review worker positioning during dusty operations.

events.title: CONTINUED DUST HAZE NEAR CONVEYOR AND STOCKPILES
events.visible_evidence: The footage continues to show airborne dust around the conveyor and nearby stockpiled material.
events.why_it_matters: Sustained dust generation may indicate that material-transfer controls need review, particularly where workers are present.
events.recommended_follow_up: Inspect the transfer and stockpile areas for dust leakage and verify the effectiveness of suppression measures.

events.title: WORKER INSIDE MATERIAL BIN WITH SHOVEL
events.visible_evidence: A worker wearing a high-visibility vest and gloves is inside the material bin and uses a shovel near the stored material.
events.why_it_matters: Working inside a bin can involve engulfment, slip/trip, and struck-by hazards if material shifts or equipment remains in operation.
events.recommended_follow_up: Confirm permit/entry controls, equipment isolation, stable material conditions, and rescue/communication arrangements.

events.title: WORKER CONTINUES MANUAL SHOVELING INSIDE BIN
events.visible_evidence: The worker continues shoveling material inside the bin at the end of the reviewed clip.
events.why_it_matters: Manual clearing near stored material and equipment may expose the worker to material movement and machinery-related hazards.
events.recommended_follow_up: Review the task method, isolation arrangements, access/egress, and supervision before the activity continues.

weights.label: YOLO subject alignment
weights.description: Share of eligible subject findings linked to a matching YOLO subject.

weights.label: Cross-model corroboration
weights.description: Share of findings also reported by another selected model within the time tolerance.

weights.label: Structured output completeness
weights.description: Share of findings with a valid title, issue category, and timestamp.

weights.label: Response speed
weights.description: Relative runtime; the fastest completed model receives the full score.

weights.label: Token efficiency
weights.description: Relative token use; the lowest total token count receives the full score.

weights.label: Cost efficiency
weights.description: Included only when actual provider-reported cost is available for every completed model.

comparison.method_note: BEST, BETTER, and GOOD are relative rankings for this recorded run, not ground-truth accuracy labels. Model agreement is a consistency signal, not proof that an observation is true. If a criterion is unavailable for any completed model, that criterion is excluded for all models and the remaining weights are renormalised.
